scope.title: Transparent top-down whole-object library and scene reuse coverage
scope.status: 46 whole-object assets approved; 125 partial scene demonstrations root-reviewed; production mapping acceptance pending
scope.claim: AI-generated whole-object library; source cutouts are comparison evidence only. Placement demonstrations use only mapped whole objects on alternate floors. Unmapped scene components are absent, not claimed restored.
scope.nonClaim: Does not claim all 524 previous cutouts are restored. 412 remain unmapped; the 125 root-reviewed placements are partial demonstrations, not production-accepted scene replacements.

corrections: Removed two giant rail-network substitutions in Swine switch chamber.
Rotated shelves 90 degrees and the bathroom toilet 180 degrees.
rootReviewedMontage.limit: Review covers meaningful whole-object appearances and scene scale; it is not production acceptance of full cutout replacements.

acceptanceChecklist.requirement: Complete isolated whole-object silhouette, including inferred covered sections; generated completion is not recovered source pixels.
No source-floor rectangles, neighboring props, room background, or shadow mat masquerading as object.
Direct overhead orientation consistent with the source scene.
Pivot and grid footprint recorded; mapping uses fitcontain-uniform without aspect stretching.
Native RGBA transparency retained; review on checker, plain light, plain dark, and alternate-floor backdrops.
acceptanceChecklist.status: whole-object sheet QA approved; sample scene integration pending

acceptanceChecklist.requirement: Review actual scene, target bounds, z order, replaced component IDs, and alternate floor before mapping acceptance.

sources.prompt: Create a professional game-sprite sheet of EXACTLY TWELVE COMPLETE STANDALONE OBJECTS, all directly OVERHEAD 90degree ORTHOGRAPHIC camera, transparent background. Layout strict FOUR COLUMNS by THREE ROWS, equal spacious cells in 1536x1024 landscape canvas. One object centered in each cell, large clear transparent margins, absolutely NO contact or overlap. No cell borders, no labels, no letters, no numbers. Use attached dungeon rooms ONLY as pixel-art/material/style reference: crisp rich GBA pixel clusters, navy/slate stone, warm brown wood, muted blue/green fabrics. Do NOT crop room imagery or preserve floor patches. RECONSTRUCT the WHOLE object including hidden portions, clean complete outer silhouette and solid interiors. These must be usable sprites, not rectangles of environment art. NO FLOOR, NO WALL ENVIRONMENT, NO GRASS PATCH, NO background, NO rugs, NO scene lighting pools, NO shadows outside silhouettes; any depth is tiny edge shading within object silhouette. Never draw a frontal or isometric view; see only TOPS. Strict rowmajor object list: ROW1 col1 round wooden BARREL TOP with iron hoops/rim; col2 square wooden CRATE TOP with complete crossed planks, all four corners; col3 complete leafy GREEN POTTED PLANT seen vertically down, full circular terracotta pot rim and radial leaves, no leaves cut off; col4 plain BLUE-UPHOLSTERED WOODEN CHAIR TOP, full square seat and narrow backrest visible along top edge. ROW2 col1 EMPTY RECTANGULAR WOODEN TABLE TOP, complete unbroken solid wood surface without books/plates/plants, no holes; col2 complete narrow FIELD COT seen vertically down, muted GREEN full blanket, white pillow and metal frame, no overlapping objects; col3 horizontal CLOSED WOODEN DOUBLE-DOOR THRESHOLD in pure overhead plan, narrow leaf tops and brass hinges, NOT upright door facade; col4 horizontal STRAIGHT NAVY STONE WALL MODULE seen from above, coherent double row of blue stone blocks, clean whole rectangle, no ground, no attached room. ROW3 col1 horizontal plain WOODEN BENCH TOP, complete rectangular planks and short supports wholly inside silhouette; col2 complete narrow FIELD COT with muted BLUE blanket, white pillow, full metal frame, no occluders; col3 complete WHEELCHAIR seen vertically down with blue seat, dark two side wheels, handles and footrest, all parts whole; col4 EMPTY rectangular WOODEN BOOKSHELF TOP/LOW COUNTER, wooden surface and perimeter rim, no books or loose objects, complete silhouette. All12 sprites complete within own cell, consistent pixel scale, transparency everywhere between objects.

Create a targeted correction sprite sheet with EXACTLY FOUR objects on transparent background,2columns2rows,1536x1024 landscape. Attached source sprite sheet is MATERIAL/PIXELSTYLE reference only. Critical change: CAMERA DIRECTLY ABOVE at90degrees, only TOP SURFACES, zero furniture legs visible, zero frontal side face, no thickness projected downward, no oval perspective. No shadows outside sprites, no floor, no background, no props on furniture, no text, generous clear transparent margins. TopLeft ONE ROUND WOODEN BARREL LID viewed vertically down: perfect CIRCLE with iron ring rim, flat wooden planks and bung, you cannot see any barrel side staves. TopRight ONE EMPTY RECTANGULAR WOODEN TABLE TOP, whole solid uninterrupted surface, narrow wooden rim, NO LEGS visible at all, no front apron, no objects, complete corners. BottomLeft ONE HORIZONTAL WOODEN BENCH TOP, flat long narrow rectangle of3whole wooden planks, ALL supports hidden directly below, NO projecting legs/feet. BottomRight ONE LOW WOODEN SHELF/COUNTER TOP, flat horizontal rectangular wood surface with subtle perimeter rim, NO LEGS or frontal shelves visible. Crisp detailed warmbrown GBA pixel illustration consistent with attachedsource, dark clean outline, complete interiors, four discrete silhouettes. This is true overhead plan-view inventory sprites, not front-facing furniture artwork.

Create a TRUE TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND sprite asset sheet, 1536x1024 landscape, precisely 4 columns by 3 rows, TWELVE complete separate whole reusable objects, one per equal cell, generous transparent padding between all objects. NO floor, ground, rugs, background, backdrop, cast floor shadows, tile rectangles, environment, labels or text. Objects must have complete clean independent alpha silhouettes. STRICT 90 degree camera straight down from zenith, orthographic top-view game sprites. Every prop seen as TOP SURFACE, no front-facing room projection, no isometric or perspective. Detailed crisp blue-slate/iron/brass GBA pixel art, cold navy metals with amber highlights. Reference image only materials/color, not its arrangement or floor. Rowmajor objects: 1 a complete circular iron toothed gear, all teeth intact, brass axle center, viewed directly above. 2 a whole mechanical red-handle lever mounted on a small complete square blue stone PLINTH, plinth is part of object but no surrounding floor, straight down top view. 3 complete straight short horizontal iron mine rail track with wooden ties, no ground under gaps. 4 complete orthogonal plus junction rail track, full crossing assembly no ground. 5 a small wall torch fixture seen from directly ABOVE as metal bracket and flame circle, no wall or floor or light pool. 6 a whole wooden crate top, square with cross braces, directly above. 7 a complete rectangular explosive cart seen directly above, four wheels visible at sides, red explosive cylinders on tray, whole chassis, no floor. 8 complete yellow bulldozer directly ABOVE, rectangular yellow engine/cab roof, two intact parallel black caterpillar tracks, wide front blade extending at one end, all parts intact. 9 whole weight bench directly above, dark padded rectangular bench and complete iron support frame footprint. 10 whole barbell directly above, horizontal dark iron bar with complete concentric weight discs both ends, no backdrop. 11 complete short blue stone wall segment seen straight above as long narrow rectangle top surface, no extra floor tile. 12 complete blue stone doorway threshold assembly top view, two wall jamb tops and open passage center, no floor filling passage. These are fully inferred new whole sprites, do not crop fragments from the reference.

Transparent standalone top-down game object asset sheet, 1536x1024, 4 columns by3rows12 complete independent objects with transparent gaps. STRICT 90degree bird eye ORTHOGRAPHIC plan, show TOPS only no frontal faces. Detailed crisp pixel art, blue slate/iron/brass/wood cold blues amber accents. NO floor, ground squares, backdrop, text or cast floor shadows. Every object whole, no cutouts. Rowmajor: 1 complete crude goblin iron throne from directly ABOVE, square red seat and narrow back edge, not upright frontal throne. 2 complete long red rectangular carpet with small gold abstract goblin insignia, flat overhead. 3 complete spiked timber barricade straight segment, top view thick timber and spikes with red cloth tied over center. 4 complete blue iron pipe ninety degree elbow with brass bands, overhead. 5 complete straight blue iron pipe section with brass bands overhead. 6 complete rectangular stone hay trough with full frame and hay contents overhead. 7 complete llama viewed directly ABOVE, whole wool back with head ears feet tail visible, no side profile. 8 complete huge round pink swine creature viewed directly ABOVE showing back small ears and tail, no gore or face. 9 complete trap cart machinery rectangular wooden/iron chassis, spiked roller and all mechanical linkage overhead, whole object not floor. 10 complete descending stone staircase module overhead as rectangle containing perfectly parallel equal width treads, no frontal archways. 11 complete overhead DOOR THRESHOLD: a single thin horizontal brass strip with tiny hinge fittings at each end, no jambs no arch no enclosed doorway, NO FRONT FACE. 12 complete circular metal drain grate with bars seen directly above. All12 clean isolated independent full silhouettes and no floor tiles around them.

Flat 2D TOP-DOWN RPG object atlas, TRANSPARENT background, 4 columns x3 rows, 12 independent fully complete objects separated by large transparent gutters. EXACT VERTICAL OVERHEAD architectural plan camera at zenith: only TOP SURFACES visible, NO vertical front face, NO legs, NO upright facades. Think satellite view floor-plan symbols drawn in rich detailed hand-pixelled GBA art. No floor under any object. All colored interior surfaces opaque. No text. Row-major: 1 white toilet top silhouette: rectangular tank at north, oval open bowl attached south, basin interior opaque blue;2 rectangular wood counter top with white recessed sink bowl, golden faucet top;3 rectangular pale litter tray top with tan granular center and thick continuous rim;4 dark slate litter scoop flat top silhouette long thin handle and slotted rectangular head;5 overhead candy-vending machine as GREEN RECTANGULAR ROOF slab with top-access GLASS HATCH showing colorful candy below, all sides hidden, NO front display panel, NO coin slot on front, no octagonal tower;6 walnut bench as simple long seat TOP PLANK rectangle, supports hidden;7 walnut empty table as uninterrupted wooden TOP RECTANGLE, no legs visible, no clutter;8 chair as green square seat TOP with slim wooden backrest TOP EDGE north, no legs or vertical backrest facade;9 flat bed TOP rectangle with red blanket and white pillows at north, frame thin outline no bedpost elevation;10 flat complete red gold ornate rectangular rug;11 potted plant TOP as radial leaves over circular pot rim, no pot side wall;12 circular small wooden side-table TOP with lamp seen as concentric circles from above, no lampstem elevation or tablelegs. Crisp pixel textures and gold accents, not vector icons, no perspective illustration. Fully usable standalone objects on any floor.
